fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Text 'KLONOA  ' (KLONOA plus two spaces). Checked at power-on; if it does not match, the game writes it and wipes 0008-01FF (all saves)
fields.evidence: code 4000:F2BE (compare F2D5, write F2E2, wipe F2F1); appears on first boot; boot reads at 4000:F2D7 frame 1

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written by the save code; wiped to zero with the rest of 0008-01FF when the signature is missing
fields.evidence: code 4000:F2E9 wipe only; always 0 in all 192 saves

fields.name: mid-vision marker
fields.meaning: FE FE = a vision in progress can be resumed: the title menu then offers 'continue from the middle of the vision'. Set to 00 00 on game over (lives below zero) and after saving to a file slot; the rest of the record is left in place
fields.evidence: code 4000:F34F write, 4000:F3DF check (title menu 4000:1616), 4000:F3FC clear (callers 4000:279F game over, 4000:F959 after file save); diffs: set on entering VISION 1-1, cleared at game over; verified resume starts VISION 1-1

fields.name: hearts
fields.meaning: Health (hearts) for the resumed vision; 3 = full, reset to 3 at vision start and after each lost life, +1 (capped at 3) from heart pickups
fields.evidence: code 4000:AFD3 (=3 at vision start), 4000:2767 (=3 after a lost life), 4000:A9C1 (=+1 pickup), read for display 4000:C4AD/C594; always 3 in saves

fields.name: lives
fields.meaning: Lives left in the vision in progress. Taken from the file record (0161) at vision start (3 on a new game), minus one per lost life; when it goes below zero the marker at 0040 is cleared (game over) and the record is not re-saved
fields.evidence: code 4000:AFE0 (from 149F), 4000:2763 (dec), 4000:278B (signed game-over test); diffs: 3,2,1,0 across lost lives, then marker cleared

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Stale RAM byte copied into the save: no instruction references it, and the vision-start init writes the bytes around it (hearts, lives, flags) but skips this one
fields.evidence: code: exhaustive reference search finds no use of RAM 13E2; always 0 in all 192 saves

fields.name: vision flags
fields.meaning: Bit flags for the vision in progress: bit 0 and bit 7 come from per-vision ROM tables, bits 1-2 copy two settings bits from the file record (017A); refreshed from the live flags at checkpoints
fields.evidence: code 4000:2423-244D (bit 0, table 4000:23FB), 4000:2466-2486 (bit 7, table 4000:2402), 4000:B005 (bits 1-2 from 14B8), 4000:B114 (checkpoint merge); always 0 in saves

fields.name: restart X
fields.meaning: Horizontal position where Klonoa restarts (checkpoint start), from a map-table entry times 16
fields.evidence: code 4000:B01A-B01F (map entry <<4 via 4000:ACD0 setup); 0x03B0 in saves (start of VISION 1-1)

fields.name: restart Y
fields.meaning: Vertical position where Klonoa restarts (checkpoint start)
fields.evidence: code 4000:B022-B028; 0x0E40 in saves

fields.name: taken-object flags
fields.meaning: Two bytes of bit flags for one-time pickups already consumed in this vision (first byte heart-type, second bonus-type; bit number from the object data); zeroed at vision start
fields.evidence: code 4000:AFA1-AFA4 (zeroed), 4000:A9BD/A949 (OR bit on pickup, plus heart/life bonus); always 0 in saves (nothing collected before saving)

fields.name: checkpoint taken flags A
fields.meaning: Snapshot of the first taken-object byte (004A) at the last checkpoint
fields.evidence: code 4000:B0E0 (from 13E8), 4000:AFCD (zeroed at start); always 0 in saves

fields.name: checkpoint taken flags B
fields.meaning: Snapshot of the second taken-object byte (004B) at the last checkpoint, refreshed from it again on each lost life
fields.evidence: code 4000:B0E6 (from 13E9), 4000:276C (refreshed at death); always 0 in saves

fields.name: checkpoint hearts
fields.meaning: Hearts snapshot at the last checkpoint or lost life (always 3: the value is reset to 3 in both cases)
fields.evidence: code 4000:B0FE (from 13E0), 4000:AFD8/2767 (=3); always 3 in saves

fields.name: checkpoint lives
fields.meaning: Lives snapshot at the last checkpoint or lost life; tracks the lives count (0043)
fields.evidence: code 4000:B104 (from 13E1), 4000:AFE3/277B; diffs track 0043 exactly (3,2,1,0)

fields.name: checkpoint stone bits, low
fields.meaning: Low half of the collected-dream-stone bitfield at the last checkpoint (one bit per stone, stones 0-15); exact stone-to-bit mapping not observed
fields.evidence: code 4000:B0EC (from RAM 13DA, bits set 4000:A8B9 on collect); always 0 in saves

fields.name: checkpoint stone bits, high
fields.meaning: High half of the collected-dream-stone bitfield at the last checkpoint (stones 16-31)
fields.evidence: code 4000:B0F2 (from RAM 13DC, bits set 4000:A8C5); always 0 in saves

fields.name: checkpoint dream stones
fields.meaning: Dream-stone count at the last checkpoint (snapshot of the in-vision counter)
fields.evidence: code 4000:B0F8 (from RAM 13DE, counted 4000:A8D9, best-of at clear 4000:ADDE); always 0 in saves

fields.name: in-vision flag
fields.meaning: A flag zeroed at vision start and tested by the in-vision code; never observed nonzero
fields.evidence: code 4000:AF9E (zeroed), reads 4000:1058/11B7/1205/1233/12E3, cleared 4000:1372; always 0 in saves

fields.name: entry point
fields.meaning: Which entry of the vision to start from (01 = vision start)
fields.evidence: code: copied with the vision number (4000:2413), set to 1 on file load (4000:F795) and next-vision advance (4000:21F3/220C); always 1 in saves

fields.name: vision number
fields.meaning: The vision in progress: high digit = world, low digit = vision (11 = VISION 1-1). 61 and 62 are two special visions that never keep a mid-vision record
fields.evidence: code 4000:AD8E (world/vision arithmetic), 4000:25FB-2610 and 4000:277E (61/62 excluded); verified resume starts VISION 1-1 with 11

fields.name: file slot 1
fields.meaning: Saved game file 1: marker FE FE then a 60-byte progress record with the same layout as the current-game record at 0140. Empty (zero) in all saves made so far
fields.evidence: code 4000:F332 with slot 1 (caller 4000:F956), read 4000:F302 (caller 4000:F78C), title/file screen scan 4000:F360; written by the save screen offered after clearing a vision (4000:187D)

fields.name: file slot 2
fields.meaning: Saved game file 2, same layout as file slot 1
fields.evidence: code 4000:F332/F302 with slot 2; loop 4000:F360 over slots 1-3; always 0

fields.name: file slot 3
fields.meaning: Saved game file 3, same layout as file slot 1
fields.evidence: code 4000:F332/F302 with slot 3; always 0

fields.name: current-game marker
fields.meaning: FE FE = the current-game progress record below is valid
fields.evidence: code 4000:F34F (save with block 4, caller 4000:24AA at vision start); diff: set when entering VISION 1-1

fields.name: world 1 best dream stones
fields.meaning: Best number of dream stones collected in each of visions 1-1 to 1-6 (one byte each, 0-30)
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADC0-ADE5 (keep the higher of old value and the vision's stone count RAM 13DE), 4000:ADEE sanity limit <31; always 0 (no vision cleared)

fields.name: world 1 stone total
fields.meaning: Best total of dream stones over world 1 (180 = all)
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADE7-AE05 (sum, max kept); world offsets (world-1)*8

fields.name: file number
fields.meaning: Which file slot (0-2) this record was last saved to, loaded from, or picked for a new game; the file screens start their cursor here
fields.evidence: code 4000:F949/F75F (stamped), 4000:F434/F437 (read back as cursor); always 0 (no file operation observed)

fields.name: world 2 best dream stones
fields.meaning: Best dream stones for visions 2-1 to 2-6
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADC0 world offset (world-1) x 8

fields.name: world 2 stone total
fields.meaning: Best total of dream stones over world 2
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADE7-AE05

fields.name: progress
fields.meaning: Furthest vision unlocked: high digit world, low digit vision (11 = 1-1 at a new game); FF = all main visions cleared. Shown on the file screen
fields.evidence: code 4000:AD56 (=11 new game), 4000:AD8E-ADB2 (advance on clear, monotonic), 4000:F386 (file screen), 4000:F78F (resume point); diff: 11 in all saves

fields.name: world 3 best dream stones
fields.meaning: Best dream stones for visions 3-1 to 3-6
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADC0

fields.name: world 3 stone total
fields.meaning: Best total of dream stones over world 3
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADE7-AE05

fields.name: completion flags
fields.meaning: Bits 0-4: world 1-5 has all 180 dream stones; bit 5: set once the extra visions are cleared
fields.evidence: code 4000:AE0F-AE2C (totals >= 180), 4000:AE51-AE5F (extras done); read 4000:F1F4-F214

fields.name: world 4 best dream stones
fields.meaning: Best dream stones for visions 4-1 to 4-6
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADC0

fields.name: world 4 stone total
fields.meaning: Best total of dream stones over world 4
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADE7-AE05

fields.name: lives carried
fields.meaning: Lives carried between visions; becomes the lives count at the next vision start. 3 at a new game. Shown on the file screen
fields.evidence: code 4000:AD51 (=3), 4000:ADBD (from lives at vision end), 4000:AFDD (to 0043), 4000:F3A6 (file screen); diff: 03 in saves

fields.name: world 5 best dream stones
fields.meaning: Best dream stones for visions 5-1 to 5-6
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADC0

fields.name: world 5 stone total
fields.meaning: Best total of dream stones over world 5
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADE7-AE05

fields.name: extra visions cleared
fields.meaning: Bit n set = extra vision 6-(n+1) cleared; the file screen shows how many of the bits are set. The all-extra-clear reward checks for exactly 0x1F (five bits)
fields.evidence: code 4000:AD71-AD87 (set on clearing vision 6x), 4000:F3B3-F3BE (bit count), 4000:AE51 (==0x1F test)

fields.name: extra-vision best stones
fields.meaning: Best dream stones for the extra visions
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADC0 with world digit 6

fields.name: extra-vision stone total
fields.meaning: Best total of dream stones over the extra visions
fields.evidence: code 4000:ADE7-AE05

fields.name: last vision played
fields.meaning: Number of the vision played last (same coding as 0061)
fields.evidence: code 4000:AED6-AED9; read 4000:F22D/F246

fields.name: best time, vision 61
fields.meaning: Best clear time of special vision 61, in frames (75 per second) as a 32-bit value stored high word first; new game value 270000 = 60:00
fields.evidence: code 4000:AD39-AD3F (default 0004 1EB0), 4000:AE82-AE99 (keep lower), 4000:AF03 (/4500 = minutes display); diff: 04 00 B0 1E in saves

fields.name: best time, vision 62
fields.meaning: Best clear time of special vision 62, same coding as 0172
fields.evidence: code 4000:AD45-AD4B, 4000:AEA5-AEBC; diff: 04 00 B0 1E

fields.name: settings bits
fields.meaning: Bits 0-2: game setting bits saved with the file (bits 1-2 are copied into the vision flags at 0045); individual bit meanings not pinned down
fields.evidence: code 4000:AEC8-AED2 (from live settings RAM 1398), 4000:AFF7-B00A; always 0 in saves

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Zeroed by the new-game init (tail of its clear loop); never used
fields.evidence: code 4000:AD2C loop covers through 14B9; no other reference; always 0

fields.name: uninitialized tail
fields.meaning: Not covered by the new-game clear loop: whatever was in RAM is copied verbatim; 0 in practice because boot clears all RAM
fields.evidence: code: AD25 loop ends at 14B9, no reference to 14BA-14BB; always 0 in all 192 saves

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Past the end of the record (marker + 60 bytes); never written
fields.evidence: code 4000:F343 (30 words)

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Inside the wiped area but never written
fields.evidence: code 4000:F2F1 wipe only; always 0

fields.name: beyond cartridge
fields.meaning: Bytes past the 8 KB window in 32 KB emulator images; never touched
fields.evidence: always 0 in all 192 saves; no code access

fields.name: shared-table ages
fields.meaning: Age of each slot in a table that several games share in the console's built-in memory: byte N is the age of slot N+1 (this game is slot 1, byte 0); 0 = just used, rising to 6. Written on every power-on
fields.evidence: code 4000:EA31-EAAB (LRU: touch zeroes, older bump, cap 6; all-6 first-boot fill); diff: 00 06 06 06 06 06 06 after first boot

fields.name: header padding
fields.meaning: High byte of header word 3; always 0
fields.evidence: code: inside the words 0-3 read/write (4000:EA31) but never set; always 0

fields.name: shared-table reserved
fields.meaning: Header words 4-5 between the ages and the first entry; never touched
fields.evidence: code: no reader or writer; always 0

fields.name: game key
fields.meaning: Key of this game's entry in the shared table (0001)
fields.evidence: code 4000:AC65 (key 1), 4000:EA06 search, 4000:EB59 write; set on first boot

fields.name: other games' entries
fields.meaning: Slots 2-7 of the shared table (other games' keys and data); all zero here
fields.evidence: code 4000:EB54 slot*6 layout; always 0 in all 192 saves

fields.name: not this game's
fields.meaning: Outside the shared table; pre-existing console data, identical before the game ever ran; nothing in the code reads or writes it
fields.evidence: identical in the blank boot image; no code access
